resources.string:
Take turns drawing one line between two neighboring dots. Draw the fourth side of a box and you claim it, then you must draw again. One line can finish two boxes at once.

When every box on the %1$d by %2$d board is claimed, whoever claimed more wins. A tie is possible on a board with an even number of boxes.

Play Again keeps the session tally and the board size, and the player who moves first alternates each board.
